newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks recoup at close despite violence.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks recoup at close despite violence.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished slightly higher on Monday, wiping out early losses amid squaring of positions on clearing day, dealers said.

"The index rose as individuals covered short positions but there was little genuine buying," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said. Stocks had dipped earlier on fears of sectarian unrest after gunmen killed 21 people in a mosque.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 3.47 points, or 0.25 percent, to close at 1,418.43. Losers led gainers 145 to 87.
PTCL fell 0.65 rupees to 34.20 rupees but Fauji Fertilizer rose 2.10 to 69.70. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
